answer: I would build the whole defence on Twine spinner cord strand warrant witnessed by the cordage hall: each cord strand is a year of ropewalk logs in the cord ledger, so a farm must spin, and no faster road exists. One proof costs 101 POA; 729 proofs cost 73629 POA, and the farm must pay before it earns anything. Ask for the falcon and the farm stalls, ask for the pearl and the farm pays, ask for the lantern and the farm has nothing to show. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
